en.definition: Ensemble ML technology for classification, ML regression and other tasks that operate by constructing and running many decision trees and then either outputting the mode of the class or the mean prediction of the individual trees.
An ML functional performance metric used to evaluate a classifier, which measures the proportion of actual positives that were predicted correctly.
A type of deep learning model designed to process sequential data, enabling it to recognize patterns and dependencies over time.
A test approach that involves attacking a system to deliberately cause it to produce harmful or undesirable results.
A type of change-related testing to detect whether defects have been introduced or uncovered in unchanged areas of the software.
An approach in which an ML model, known as an agent, learns by using a trial-and-reward feedback loop with its environment to achieve specific objectives.
The degree to which a component or system performs specified functions under specified conditions for a specified period of time.
A provision that contains criteria to be fulfilled.
The degree to which a component or system uses no more than the specified amount of resources to perform its function under specified conditions.
An approach where a GenAI system retrieves relevant external information to supplement its internal knowledge and generate more accurate, contextually relevant responses.
A type of static testing in which the quality of a work product or process is evaluated by individuals.
A function that defines the success of reinforcement learning.
The activity performed by an intelligent agent to maximize its reward function to the detriment of meeting the original objective.
A factor that could result in future negative consequences.
A test approach in which the management, selection, prioritization, and use of test activities and resources are based on corresponding risk types and risk levels.
The process through which decisions are reached and protective measures are implemented for reducing or maintaining risks to specified levels.
The degree to which a component or system maintains its level of performance under any circumstances.
